chunks: And it has indeed been narrated in another report:
Whoever dies and has no heir, then his wealth belongs to his hamshahrīj.
Meaning, the people of his town.

key_terms.فَمَالُهُ: his wealth or estate left after death
key_terms.لِهَمْشَهْرِيجِهِ: for his hamshahrīj, referring here to a local communal claimant
key_terms.وَارِثٌ: an heir entitled to inherit from the deceased

ai.seo_question: What happens to the wealth of someone who dies without an heir in this hadith?
ai.summary: This report states a ruling concerning the estate of a person who dies without any heir. It explains that such wealth goes to his hamshahrīj, clarified here as the people of his town.
